title: Lessons from finished tasks
footer_on: Learned when tasks of this project were accepted after corrections. New Agents of this project get the most repeated ones before they start. Edit one that is wrong; a deleted one is not learned again.
footer_off: Learning from finished tasks is off (Settings › Persona): no new lessons are learned, and new Agents don't get these. Edit or delete them here.
edit_hint: Say it the way you want new Agents of this project to read it.
delete_body: New Agents of this project stop getting it, and Persona won't learn it again.
changed_elsewhere: This lesson changed on another device. Here is the latest.
